Any model that does not adapt is frozen: it keeps its weights and uses the test batch's normalization statistics. Hyperparameters of the adapting models: batch size 64. The optimizer depends on the entropy the models minimize. Models that adapt on their own entropy: ViT-B/16: SGD (learning rate $7 \times 10^{-5}$, momentum 0.9, dampening 0, weight decay 0, no Nesterov).
